question: 11th National Seed Congress was held in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gwalior**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 11th National Seed Congress was held in **Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh**, India, from February 25-27, 2022. ​

 
• The theme of the Congress was "**Seeds for Sustainable Agriculture**." 
 
• The Congress was inaugurated by the Union Minister of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, **Shri Narendra Singh Tomar**.
 
• The Congress was attended by over** 2,000 delegates** from all over India, including scientists, farmers, seed industry representatives, and policymakers. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Seed Congress was established in **1986**.
 
• The first National Seed Congress was held in** New Delhi**. 
 
• The National Seed Congress has been held **every two years** since 1986.
